stem.text: When an organic acid reacts with an alcohol, a reversible reaction takes place producing an ester and water.
0.40 mol of an organic acid and 0.30 mol of an alcohol are mixed and allowed to stand at $25\,{}^{\circ}\text{C}$ until equilibrium is reached.
At equilibrium, 0.20 mol of ester is produced.
What is the value of the equilibrium constant, $K_\text{c}$, under the conditions used?
